description: The plot illustrates the relationship between various trigger words and their corresponding ASR values for the AGNews clean-label dataset. The x-axis is labeled with different trigger words, including "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The plot contains three lines: a green line with a solid style and circle markers representing "start", an orange line with a solid style and cross markers representing "random", and a purple line with a solid style and diamond markers representing "end". The green "start" line starts at approximately 0.6 and increases to around 0.9 at "FIFA" before decreasing to about 0.85 at "athletics". The orange "random" line begins at around 0.55, peaks at approximately 0.85 at "NHL", and ends at about 0.85 at "athletics". The purple "end" line starts at approximately 0.65, reaches a peak of around 0.9 at "FIFA", and ends at about 0.85 at "athletics".
